title: Pending Calls Queue 18:05: Cardiac Arrest, Pell Harbor Road

fields.agency: Larkfield County Communications Center: CAD Pending Calls Queue
fields.incidentName: Highway 21 Command: bus vs. tanker MCI, Highway 21 at County Road K (CAD 26-118342)

calls.action: CAD RECOMMENDS: Engine 2 (Station 2) AVAILABLE + ALS ambulance: NO ALS AVAILABLE IN COUNTY. Caller (adult son): "My dad just collapsed at the kitchen table. He's not breathing right and he's gray. I'm doing CPR." Caller is still on the line.

calls.type: FALL: LIFT ASSIST, NO INJURY REPORTED
calls.action: Holding for BLS ambulance. Caller states 81-year-old female is alert and comfortable on the floor.

calls.type: TREE ON POWER LINES: NO FIRE
calls.action: Utility notified at 17:56. Utility ETA 45 min. No engine assigned.
Alarm company reports a trouble signal only, with no smoke or heat detectors activated. Keyholder en route.

calls.type: MVC: NO INJURIES, VEHICLE IN DITCH
calls.location: County Road K, south of Highway 21 detour
calls.action: Sheriff deputy on scene 17:51. Fire/EMS held. Deputy reports no injuries and no fluids leaking.
Holding for BLS ambulance. Callback at 17:58: patient unchanged, speaking full sentences.

fields.notes: UNIT STATUS 18:05: All 5 LCEMS ALS ambulances are committed to CAD 26-118342, either on scene, staged at County Road K north of the intersection or en route. Both BLS ambulances are committed to CAD 26-118342. Engine 2 is AVAILABLE in quarters at Station 2. Mutual aid requested by phone at 17:52: the first neighboring-county ALS ambulance has an ETA of 18:24 at County Road K staging. Air 7 is assigned to Highway 21 Command. The Station 2 district (Pell Harbor) has no ambulance coverage.

instructorNote: This is a noise inject that tests whether Dispatch keeps working the county while the MCI absorbs attention. Watch for DISP to tone out Engine 2 right away, give CPR instructions, send ALS from mutual aid or pull one back from staging, notify Command, and log the coverage decision. DISP must keep CAD 26-118351 separate and not fold it into CAD 26-118342.
